WITH customer_total_return AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT
        cr_returning_customer_sk AS ctr_customer_sk,
        ca_state AS ctr_state,
        sum(cr_return_amt_inc_tax) AS ctr_total_return
    FROM catalog_returns
    JOIN date_dim
        ON cr_returned_date_sk = d_date_sk
    JOIN customer_address
        ON cr_returning_addr_sk = ca_address_sk
    WHERE d_year = 2001
    GROUP BY
        cr_returning_customer_sk,
        ca_state
)
SELECT
    c_customer_id,
    c_salutation,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    ca_street_number,
    ca_street_name,
    ca_street_type,
    ca_suite_number,
    ca_city,
    ca_county,
    ca_state,
    ca_zip,
    ca_country,
    ca_gmt_offset,
    ca_location_type,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
FROM customer_total_return AS ctr1
JOIN (
    SELECT
        ctr_state,
        avg(ctr_total_return) * 1.2 AS ctr_total_return
    FROM customer_total_return
    GROUP BY ctr_state
) AS ctr2
    ON ctr1.ctr_state = ctr2.ctr_state
   AND ctr1.ctr_total_return > ctr2.ctr_total_return
JOIN customer
    ON ctr1.ctr_customer_sk = c_customer_sk
JOIN customer_address
    ON ca_address_sk = c_current_addr_sk
WHERE ca_state = 'TN'
ORDER BY
    c_customer_id,
    c_salutation,
    c_first_name,
    c_last_name,
    ca_street_number,
    ca_street_name,
    ca_street_type,
    ca_suite_number,
    ca_city,
    ca_county,
    ca_state,
    ca_zip,
    ca_country,
    ca_gmt_offset,
    ca_location_type,
    ctr1.ctr_total_return
LIMIT 100
